title: Sangamo Therapeutics
summary: US biotech developing zinc-finger gene therapies and genome editing.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Sangamo develops gene therapies using zinc-finger nucleases and AAV delivery, with programmes in haemophilia, lysosomal storage disease and neurology. It licenses its editing technology to partners and has faced funding constraints. Clinical and partnership progress determines survival.

Technology Exposure

  • Zinc-finger gene editing
  • AAV gene therapy
  • Technology licensing

What To Watch

  • Clinical trial funding
  • Partner deals
  • Cash runway

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
